posts.text:
I ran on fixing the damn roads and bridges in communities across Michigan.
 
Today, I’m so excited to be at the reopening of the Miller Rotunda Bridge, a key piece of infrastructure that supports our economy and connects people to the heart of Dearborn.

Powered by Michigan’s free breakfast and lunch, students are stepping into the world of sustainable food and making their own healthy smoothies.

posts.text:
1.4 million kids + 180 school days + 2 free meals a day = focused students and relieved parents.
 
Free breakfast and lunch is an equation for success. It helps kids stay focused in class while saving parents an extra $1,000 PER year, PER child.
 
Let’s make it permanent!

posts.text:
Last year the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force released a report with proven strategies to save more lives in Michigan.

Today, I'm signing an executive order to take focused action to make these recommendations a reality. Here's how we further protect our communities ⬇️
posts.quote:
Last year the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force released a report with proven strategies to save more lives in Michigan.

Today, I'm signing an executive order to take focused action to make these recommendations a reality. Here's how we further protect our communities ⬇️

posts.text:
I am proud of our progress:

✅Universal Background Checks
✅Safe storage requirements
✅Stronger red flag laws
✅Record investments in public safety
✅Establishing the first ever Gun Violence Prevention Task Force

We’ve got a lot done, but we can’t stop here.

We need action.
